svg.title: The mode machine (measured transitions)
svg.desc: Each node is a value of the mode nibble M(09) with its own screen; arrows are transitions seen in emulation.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Nodes: values of the mode nibble M(09), each drawn with its own screen. Arrows: every mode change seen in the scenarios.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Arrow labels say what caused it; hover an arrow for the instruction that wrote the new mode.

svg.text: Modes 2–8 are the seven menu icons in order: the icon cursor is the mode itself, and A steps it (0x0268). After MEDIC, A wraps back to home.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: idle = a menu left untouched returns home when the counter M(2D), reset by every key, reaches 60 (0x0866).

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Submodes M(0A) are each screen's pages and animation steps and are not drawn.
